public_url.name: HTTPS address
public_url.description: Use a domain name you control. Keep it after creating your account: passkeys depend on it.

certificate.name: Certificate file
certificate.description: In this app's Configuration enter the certificate filename fullchain.pem and private key filename privkey.pem. Enter your HTTPS domain with port 8448 for Stable or 8449 for Main. Use your configured host port if different. Keep /ssl read-only. No change to Home Assistant Core HTTPS is needed.

private_key.name: Private key file
private_key.description: In this app's Configuration enter the certificate filename fullchain.pem and private key filename privkey.pem. Enter your HTTPS domain with port 8448 for Stable or 8449 for Main. Use your configured host port if different. Keep /ssl read-only. No change to Home Assistant Core HTTPS is needed.

gateway_auth.name: Extra gateway access code
gateway_auth.description: Restart this app after saving the settings. Open your HTTPS address in a new tab. The browser must show no certificate warning. Complete Nocturne's account/passkey setup and test a second device.

skip_gateway_check.name: Deliberately skip gateway check
skip_gateway_check.description: Only with gateway_auth off. Skip the wrapper authentication check for intentional anonymous access; Nocturne access/share settings still decide permissions. Default off. Save and restart.

language.name: Language
language.description: We will help you get Nocturne working, one step at a time.
